requirements.description: Shipped legacy fragments and all five adapter installs satisfy the bundled legacy schema.
acceptance_criteria: Given each shipped adapter, when scaffolded, then every contract fragment and the assembly validate.

requirements.description: The versioned complete contract rejects missing required sections and invalid typed acceptance/check data.
acceptance_criteria: Given malformed or incomplete data, when validated, then the CLI returns a nonzero result.

requirements.description: Validation rejects ambiguity, path escapes, symlinks, cycles and invalid references without running commands.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hostile local specification, when validated, then it fails without shell execution or remote resolution.

requirements.description: Delivery requires fresh evidence from separately trusted CI and review authorities.
acceptance_criteria: Given missing, tampered, stale, skipped or self-approved evidence, when verification runs, then delivery is refused.

requirements.description: The release candidate is built and tested with pinned dependencies before publication.
acceptance_criteria: Given the package, when checked, then dependencies are exact, no lifecycle scripts execute, and shipped files contain the validator/schema/templates.
